scope.metric: normalized MSE, not RMSE; fixed train scales; clean coarse future targets

verification.source_manifest_note: 179 binding source entries plus 3 launch-time binding/unit-proof entries =182 native before/after sources.

cost.note: Native job wall and subtree CPU are distinct quantities; do not add wall and CPU or multiply by models. This includes qualification, migration, formal updates and evaluation in one native job. Historical 96 formal updates costs remain separate.

warnings: All12 models are research candidates. This toy comparison provides no real-grid val/test, unknown structure recovery, latent-coordinate uniqueness or safety claim.
512 equal updates do not demonstrate matched convergence. Retain late loss trends rather than interpret prediction difference as representation-error lower bound.
Endpoint training.pt SHA is independently checked, but this extraction never deserializes Adam/RNG tensors; actual shared checkpoint/restore checks are native-run evidence.
Positive six paired differences are descriptive repeated-seed directions, not statistical significance.
Port coefficient is coordinate-dependent and is not interpreted as true-device parameter recovery.
noise_summary_definition: Per-noise per-form arithmetic mean across3 training seeds. The worst field is mean of each model worst-event MSE, not pooled maximum.
